text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Yemeni leader rejects any intervention on Iraq's internal affairs.
- Trade minister meets chairman of Istanbul chamber of commerce.
- Head of the Iraqi industries' union meets French businessmen.
(The above stories were also carried by THAWRA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Iraq to produce different kind of ink as from the beginning of next month.
